technical.summary: Short-term momentum is rising with strong RSI and volume confirmation, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, limiting conviction for a swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest create a weak fundamental backdrop with elevated earnings risk in 49 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral with slight bearish bias (39.9%); insufficient data to establish conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (193.9) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 49 days adds event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum is accelerating with rising RSI, positive OBV, force index cross-up, and bullish supertrend/hull/psar signals suggesting near-term upside potential toward 100.93 resistance.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains structurally below all major moving averages (EMA/SMA 50/200) and Ichimoku cloud, macro environment is severely adverse (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), fundamental backdrop is weak with high earnings risk in 49 days, and no institutional/insider conviction supports entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (RSI, OBV, supertrend) show acceleration, but structural price weakness below all major moving averages and Ichimoku cloud severely limits conviction for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment is in crisis mode (inverted yield curve, VIX 193.9) with earnings event risk in 49 days; price remains below key support levels, creating asymmetric downside risk.
